question: Can a fixed 1:1 original/native-format-matched training mixture preserve JPEG robustness while reducing clean-image costs of the matched global expert?
scope: Exploratory study on repeatedly inspected ADM/BigGAN development data; not a new blind final evaluation.
controls: Frozen same-runtime Round8 A unmatched and matched global heads; verify logits against archived raw batches. No control refit or architecture change.

training.classes: 750 Real and 750 SD15, exact Round8 expert_fit identities
training.views: Stack original expert_fit_clean_0 global features and same-ID native-size-format-matched expert_fit_clean_1 features as two training observations, not an averaged feature.
training.scaler: StandardScaler fit on both equally represented training views; uniform .5 weighting has the same population mean/variance as unweighted 2N rows. Scaler never sees selection or development.
training.classifier: Unchanged LogisticRegression(C=1,solver=liblinear,max_iter=2000,random_state=20261018), explicit sample_weight=.5 for all 3000 rows.
training.encoder: Existing frozen CLIP ViT-B/32; no image extraction or backbone updates.
training.format_matching: Unchanged Round8 deterministic native-resolution JPEG Q60..95 before original geometry; no new draw, JPEG/resize augmentation or ratio search.

selection: Full original Round8 selection identities, 125 Real +125 SD15 per seed. Same original clean/jpeg70/resize05 features for every arm. Recompute each arm's fixed threshold by existing Youden-J tie rule. No model/hyperparameter selection; JPEG50 not used for tuning.
evaluation: Original never-format-matched development Real300 + ADM300 + BigGAN300; report clean/jpeg70/jpeg50/resize05. Source selection reporting is descriptive and optimistic.
primary_comparison: paired_half minus matched global expert; unmatched is a historical-cost reference, never a substitute for the stronger matched baseline.

aggregates.overall: Equal mean of 2 fake generators x4 conditions and3 data seeds
aggregates.jpeg: Equal mean of ADM/BigGAN xJPEG70/JPEG50 and3 seeds
aggregates.clean_BigGAN: Mean of BigGAN clean over3 seeds
aggregates.clean_ADM: Mean of ADM clean over3 seeds

point_guards.note: Working tolerances fixed before fitting/outcome scoring, not domain-standard noninferiority margins.

uncertainty: 1000 class-stratified paired original-image bootstrap draws, seed20261108; common Real draws across generators and same identities across conditions, models and data seeds. Conditional on fitted heads; shared source/development pools do not give independent data-seed replications.

decision.point_guard_failure: not_supported_for_joint_goal; report which costs/gains caused failure without hiding a real partial benefit
decision.all_point_guards_pass: promising_but_uncertain unless all interval conditions also pass
decision.interval_conditions: Paired95% conditional lower bounds >0 for overall and clean_BigGAN; JPEG pooled lower bound >=-.01. All point guards must also pass.
decision.all_pass: supported_on_this_development_setup_only; fresh final validation still needed

exclusions: No final/reserved manifests/images/predictions; no new gate, local-head refit, model/ratio/C sweep, or performance-driven retry.
freeze: Record runner hash, input hashes and exact partitions before training; freeze all3 heads and thresholds before development prediction.
